audit_name: VISION 100M Assistant-Response Loss Masking Forensic Audit

flaw_1_off_by_one.code_snippet: for k in range(min(len(tgt), asst_pos + 1)): tgt[k] = pad_id
flaw_1_off_by_one.root_cause: Because range() was indexed to asst_pos + 1, k evaluated at asst_pos, setting tgt[asst_pos] = pad_id.
flaw_1_off_by_one.impact: In next-token prediction, when inp is at asst_pos (the <assistant> tag), the target token was masked to pad_id. The model was never taught what to predict when seeing <assistant>! For single-token answers ('42', 'Paris'), 100% of the answer was masked, leaving only </assistant> and <eos>.

flaw_2_truncation_fallback.code_snippet: else: half = len(tgt) // 2; for k in range(half): tgt[k] = pad_id
flaw_2_truncation_fallback.root_cause: When prompts were > 128 tokens, <assistant> was chopped off, and the second half of the user prompt was treated as response target.
flaw_2_truncation_fallback.impact: 7.69% of corpus samples trained the model to predict user instructions.

flaw_3_whitespace_unigram_bias.root_cause: Across the remaining unmasked response bodies, token 55 (' ') accounted for 4.12% of tokens (highest unigram). In only 10 updates, the model learned the argmax of this unmasked distribution.
flaw_3_whitespace_unigram_bias.impact: Caused output collapse to whitespace ' ' in recovered model.

corrected_implementation_verification.corrected_code: for k in range(asst_pos): tgt[k] = pad_id
corrected_implementation_verification.verification: Correctly preserves tgt[asst_pos] (first response token) and all subsequent response tokens up to <eos>.
